integrity: The claim is a symbolic asymptotic specialization of the finite-parameter stochastic failure bound in arXiv:2610.02137v1. No finite experiment, inaccessible source, or numerical fit is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is sufficient only; it does not prove that \(m=\Theta((\log n)^{1/\alpha})\) is necessary or optimal.
No distance scaling for the transformed family is asserted.
The fixed-noise assumption requires \(p<p_{\rm RG}\), and constants are uniform only for seed families with uniformly bounded check weight and qubit degree.
Seed families that already have single-shot suppression can fall under the stronger enhancement theorem of the source.
title: Polylogarithmic universal overhead gives near-linear-dimension single-shot QLDPC families
